title: verbascum cheiranthifolium var. asperulum
intro: Verbascum cheiranthifolium var. asperulum, commonly known as mullein, is a biennial herb that belongs to the Scrophulariaceae family. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include soothing dry coughs and reducing inflammation. The health benefits of mullein are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of mullein include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
